texts: How a sentence becomes a textured 3D model, and where the job goes when a GPU fails

A text prompt on the Forge runs through two chains: one paints a reference picture, the other rebuilds it as a textured 3D model on our own NVIDIA GPUs on Cloud Run. When a worker fails mid-job, the job moves to the next engine under the same id. The write-up covers the lanes, the rescue order and the limits: three.ws/forge

altText: A 3D model generated on the Forge from a text prompt, shown in its viewer on a dark background: a Greek hoplite in a polished bronze cuirass and crested helmet, with a red tunic, bronze greaves, sandals and a round shield held at his side

editor.summary: Every factual claim in the head post and article body is backed by a passing verification result against live pages, worker health endpoints, or source files, and the link resolves. The voice contract is fully respected (mechanism lead, no hashtags, emoji, dashes or hype) and the cover image matches its alt text and shows real Forge output, so this ships unchanged.
